title: Stella and the Gentle Moon
prompt: A shy little star who's afraid of the dark discovers that the moonlight is always watching over her

Stella.name: Stella
Stella.appearance: A tiny, soft-glowing star with a pale golden body, rosy pink cheeks, big round silver eyes, and five small rounded points. She wears a delicate ribbon of stardust around one point like a scarf. She is noticeably smaller than other stars.
Stella.personality: Shy, timid, gentle, curious, brave when encouraged
Stella.notes: Her glow flickers and dims when she is scared, and shines brightly when she feels safe and happy.

Luna.name: Luna
Luna.appearance: A large, serene crescent moon with a soft silver-white glow, gentle closed eyes with long lashes, a warm smile, and a crown of tiny twinkling stars along her top curve. Her surface has soft, pearlescent craters that look like freckles.
Luna.notes: Luna's light is steady and never flickers. She speaks in a calm, comforting way.

The Other Stars.name: The Other Stars
The Other Stars.appearance: Bright, confident stars of various sizes and colors — blue, white, and yellow. They have cheerful faces and twinkle boldly against the night sky.
The Other Stars.notes: They mean well but don't understand why Stella is afraid.

locations.The Twilight Sky: A transitional sky with warm orange and pink fading into deep blue and indigo. Wispy, soft purple-tinted clouds float gently. The horizon still holds the last glow of sunset.
locations.The Horizon Sky: The edge of the sky where a soft silver-white glow rises. The landscape below is silhouetted in dark blue — rolling hills and treetops. The sky above is deep indigo.
locations.The Moonlit Sky: A deep blue night sky bathed in soft, pearlescent silver moonlight. Gentle beams of light stretch across the sky. A few fluffy clouds catch the silver glow on their edges.
locations.The Starlit Sky: A rich, velvety indigo sky filled with colorful twinkling stars. Silver moonlight mixes with golden starlight creating a magical, sparkling atmosphere. The darkness feels soft and beautiful.
locations.The Night Sky: A wide, expansive view of the full night sky in deep midnight blue. Stars of all sizes twinkle peacefully. The overall feeling is vast but comforting, like a beautiful cosmic blanket.

bible.visual_style: Soft, dreamy watercolor and digital illustration style with gentle gradients. Rounded, cute character designs with big expressive eyes. Rich indigo and deep blue night skies with warm golden and silver glowing elements. Soft light effects, sparkles, and translucent layers. Cozy, bedtime-story atmosphere with a palette of midnight blue, silver, warm gold, soft pink, and lavender.

scenes.title: The Sky Wakes Up
scenes.text: Every evening, when the sun dipped below the hills, the sky would fill with stars popping awake one by one. They twinkled and danced, eager to light up the night. But one little star named Stella stayed hidden behind a fluffy cloud, her tiny glow barely a flicker.
scenes.description: A beautiful twilight sky transitioning from orange to deep blue. Several bright stars are popping into view with cheerful expressions, twinkling boldly. In the lower corner, a small fluffy purple-tinted cloud has a tiny pale golden star peeking out from behind it, looking nervous with big worried silver eyes. Her glow is very dim.
scenes.mood: Peaceful but with a hint of loneliness

scenes.title: Afraid of the Dark
scenes.text: Stella was afraid of the dark. It seemed so big and so empty, stretching on forever and ever. The other stars called out to her, but Stella just hugged her little points close and wished the night would end.
scenes.description: Close-up of Stella behind the cloud, hugging her five rounded points together like a child hugging their knees. Her silver eyes are wide with fear, and her rosy cheeks look pale. The background is a vast, deep dark blue-black sky that feels enormous and empty. A few distant stars twinkle far away, looking very small against the darkness.

scenes.title: A Silver Glow Appears
scenes.text: Then, something wonderful happened. A soft, silvery light began to rise over the horizon, gentle as a lullaby. It was Luna, the crescent moon, floating up into the sky with a warm and steady glow.
scenes.description: The horizon glows with a soft silver-white light as Luna the crescent moon rises gracefully. Luna has a serene face with gentle closed eyes, long lashes, and a warm smile. Tiny stars form a crown along her top curve. The dark sky around her is now bathed in a comforting pearlescent glow. Stella peeks out from her cloud, eyes wide with wonder, her glow slightly brighter.

scenes.title: Luna's Gentle Words
scenes.text: "Hello, little one," Luna whispered softly. "I see you hiding. You don't have to be afraid — I am here, and I will always be here to watch over you." Stella blinked her big silver eyes and felt something warm bloom inside her tiny chest.
scenes.description: Luna's large crescent face is close to Stella, with a gentle, nurturing smile and half-open kind eyes. A beam of soft silver moonlight stretches from Luna to Stella like a gentle blanket. Stella floats just in front of the cloud, looking up at Luna with wonder and a small hopeful smile. Stella's golden glow is growing a little brighter, and her rosy cheeks are pinker.

scenes.title: A Brave Little Step
scenes.text: With Luna's silver light wrapping around her like a hug, Stella took a deep breath and floated out from behind her cloud. The dark didn't feel so scary anymore — not with the moon's gentle glow right beside her.
scenes.description: Stella floats out from behind the cloud into the open sky, her little points stretched out bravely. A visible trail of soft silver moonlight from Luna wraps around Stella like a translucent scarf or blanket. Stella's glow is now a warm, steady golden light. The dark sky around her is beautifully dotted with other stars, and the darkness now looks soft and velvety rather than scary.

scenes.title: Dancing with the Stars
scenes.text: The other stars cheered when they saw Stella shining so brightly. They twirled and sparkled around her, and for the first time, Stella twirled right back, laughing as stardust sprinkled from her happy little points.
scenes.description: A joyful scene with Stella in the center, glowing brightly golden with a big happy smile, spinning and trailing sparkling stardust from her points. Around her, several colorful stars — blue, white, and yellow — are dancing and twirling with cheerful expressions. Luna watches from above with a proud, warm smile, her silver light bathing the whole scene. The sky is a rich, beautiful indigo filled with sparkles.

scenes.title: A Promise in the Sky
scenes.text: As the night went on, Stella looked up at Luna and smiled. "Will you always be here?" she asked. Luna smiled back and whispered, "Every single night, little star. The dark is never truly dark — because you and I will always light it up together."
scenes.description: A tender, quiet moment. Stella floats close to Luna, looking up with grateful, shining silver eyes and a peaceful smile. Luna gazes down at Stella with loving, half-closed eyes and a soft smile. The sky around them is calm and beautiful, with a blanket of softly twinkling stars. A gentle silver glow connects them like an invisible bond. The overall feeling is serene and safe.

scenes.title: The Bravest Little Star
scenes.text: And from that night on, Stella was never afraid of the dark again. Because she knew that no matter how big the night seemed, the moon was always watching over her — and her own little light was stronger than she ever imagined.
scenes.description: A wide, beautiful panorama of the night sky. Stella shines brightly in the center foreground, glowing with confident golden light, a happy and peaceful expression on her face. Luna's crescent glows serenely in the upper portion of the sky, watching over everything. The entire sky is filled with twinkling stars, and the darkness looks beautiful and velvety, not scary at all. Soft clouds drift below like a peaceful sea.
